column1: # concept-aliases.tsv: different words, same system (prior-work, 11-12). One line: <phrase|phrase|...> TAB <concept,concept,...>
# Phrases match whole words in lowercased, singularised text (label, task, branch name, READY post). A concept's own name
# (wisp-summon -> "wisp summon") always matches too. Add a line when a dupe slipped through under new words.
# Optional third column 'broad': an area, not one system (boss, tutorial, hud...). It adds to the score and shows in the prompt
# block, but never makes a match HIGH (only a specific system shared with an active item refuses a start).
